_meta.purpose: How scripts/fetch_pump_stations.py finds the 배수·빗물펌프장 file datasets on data.go.kr, and which of them scripts/build_pump_stations.py may use. The national MOIS file (15025388) is a count per 시도, not a facility list; the KRC pump list (15131996) is agricultural pumps without locations.
_meta.notes_on_rules: exclude_name_pattern: underpass (지하차도), manhole (맨홀) and sewage (하수) pumps drain a road or a sewer, not a levee-enclosed 제내지, so they say nothing about river-flood defences. address_check_km: a publisher coordinate farther than this from the 시군구 (else 시도) its own address names is dropped as a coordinate error (e.g. 대구 중구 underpass pumps placed in 합천군), never moved.

exclude_datasets.15025388: 행정안전부_배수펌프장 현황 — counts per 시도, no facilities
exclude_datasets.15131996: 한국농어촌공사_펌프 정보 — pump units, no locations
exclude_datasets.15047864: 구미시 농경지용수공급시설(배수장) — irrigation supply, not flood drainage
exclude_datasets.15127297: 김천시 농업용배수펌프장 — agricultural drainage, kept out of urban flood defences
exclude_datasets.15063526: 파주시 하수펌프장 — sewage pumping, not flood drainage
